subject: Zenora RFI: technical control mapping and evidence pipeline
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita@zenora.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Walker <tom.walker@zenora.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zenora RFI: SIG matrix and sample evidence request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is the RFI spreadsheet our procurement and security teams consolidated — the company is specifically asking for a mapping from the SIG control families to Redwood's SOC 2 controls and ISO 27001 Annex A references, plus representative evidence for the controls called out as high-risk.

Two clarifying asks up front:
- Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 Type 2 report and the ISO scope should be treated as the authoritative control set, or should we produce a crosswalk that treats SIG as the superset?
- We have a target date for the vendor security review by Nov 15; ideally we need the crosswalk and the first tranche of artifacts in ~2 weeks.

Deliverables that would be most useful to our reviewers:
- Control concordance spreadsheet (SIG -> SOC 2 control id -> ISO Annex A)
- An evidence index with links and short descriptions (what the file shows, time window, redactions if any)
- Samples: access-control policy, recent IAM role export, sample rotation logs, one week of SIEM ingest summary

I've attached our consolidated questionnaire (zenora_rfi_questionnaire.xlsx). Please let me know if you need a narrower scope or if you want us to accept a partial delivery first.

Best,
Anita
Anita Rao
Senior Security Program Manager
Zenora Systems

--- attachment: zenora_rfi_questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1.4MB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Rao <anita@zenora.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2027 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Zenora RFI: SIG matrix and sample evidence request

Anita — thanks, received and reviewed the spreadsheet.

Short answers first:
- We will deliver a SIG -> SOC 2 (control id) -> ISO 27001 Annex A crosswalk (SIG treated as superset) and flag which controls map to Redwood's SOC 2 Type 2 scope.
- We can produce the initial crosswalk + an evidence index within two weeks (target Nov 11 delivery for tranche 1).

Who will own what on our side: Karthik will produce the control mapping and identify which SOC 2 controls are in-scope for the Type 2 report; Jasmine will curate artifacts and create the evidence index; I will own the packaging, redaction guidance, and the walkthrough with your reviewers.

Couple of clarifying items to lock the scope:
1) System boundary: is Zenora restricting review to the hosted hosted/redwood-managed API (hosted inference) or should we include Dedicated/Private deployment docs as well? Please confirm — this changes which artifacts we pull.
2) ISO: is the expectation a formal Annex A mapping (A.5–A.18) or just a high-level reference?

Proposed cadence:
- Week 1 (Oct 29–Nov 4): control mapping draft + evidence index skeleton; internal artifact pulls start immediately.
- Week 2 (Nov 5–Nov 11): artifact delivery tranche 1 (policies + sampled logs) and control mapping v1 for your review.
- After Nov 11: walkthrough and follow-up artifacts; final tranche by Nov 15 if agreed.

If that works, we'll kick off internal work today. I'll schedule a 30-minute technical walkthrough for the week following tranche 1 (proposed Nov 3 at 10am PT) — will send an invite once you confirm preferred attendees.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security & Trust Lead | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: (internal)
Date: Fri, 29 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: Zenora RFI — artifact sprint plan and owners

Karthik / Jasmine — spinning up the Zenora evidence sprint. Highlighted asks below; goal is tranche 1 ready by Nov 11 and a short deliverable set for the Nov 3 walker.

Top-level scope (per Anita): SIG crosswalk -> SOC 2 -> ISO Annex A references. Zenora will treat SIG as superset. They want representative artifacts for high-risk controls first.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Karthik: produce control concordance spreadsheet (SIG id -> SOC2 control -> ISO Annex ref). Include a column "in-scope for 2027 SOC2 Type 2?" and short rationale. ETA: Nov 4 EOD.
- Jasmine: compile artifacts and create evidence index. Priority items: access-control policy (latest), IAM roles export (last 30 days), key rotation proof (KMS rotation logs sample), sample SIEM summary (last 7 days), patch/change management ticket excerpt for a major release. ETA: initial index Nov 8. Path for artifacts: s3://redwood-evidence/zenora/ (we will redact PII and rotate any keys).
- Soojin: packaging, redaction guidance, external cover note, and the walkthrough. I'll prepare the evidence index template and the redaction checklist.

Constraints / notes:
- Avoid delivering full log streams. Provide short, time-bounded extracts and an index that points to origin (ticket id, runbook, snapshot timestamp).
- For ISO Annex A mapping, use the Annex IDs (A.5–A.18). If a control is not directly covered by SOC 2 standard wording, annotate why and propose compensating evidence.

Attachments I will produce for the external tranche: control-mapping-zenora.xlsx (draft), redwood_socs2-summary-2027.pdf (scope + auditor statement), evidence-index-template.csv.

If you hit blockers (access to S3 buckets or KMS logs), flag immediately to infra@redwood.ai.

Thanks — will follow up with the shared folder links once I have the first drafts.

Soojin

Subject: Deliverable: Zenora RFI — tranche 1 (control crosswalk + evidence index)

Anita / Tom / Priya —

Attached is tranche 1 for the RFI: a draft SIG -> SOC 2 -> ISO Annex A crosswalk and an evidence index with representative artifacts. This is an initial delivery to help your reviewers triage the high-risk controls; additional artifacts and context will arrive in tranche 2 per the cadence below.

What’s included in tranche 1 (attachments):
- control-mapping-zenora.xlsx: draft mapping with in-scope flags and short notes for each mapping entry.
- redwood_socs2-summary-2027.pdf: short summary of Redwood's SOC 2 Type 2 scope and auditor statement.
- evidence-index-template.csv: index rows referencing artifact name, short description, origin, time window, and redaction notes.

Quick status and pending items:
- Completed: policy docs, IAM role export (sample), KMS rotation log excerpt, brief SIEM ingest summary for selected days.
- Pending (tranche 2): change-management ticket excerpts that show approvals for the last two major releases, additional SIEM retention samples, and a limited set of network segmentation diagrams called out under ISO A.13.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm Nov 3 10:00 AM PT for a 30-minute technical walkthrough with your security reviewers. I'll send the calendar invite with a Drive folder link.
2) You review the tranche 1 attachments and flag any immediate gaps by EOD Nov 5.
3) We will deliver tranche 2 (remaining artifacts) by Nov 11 and a final consolidation by Nov 15 if needed.

Links to tranche 1 (read-only):
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bZenoraEvidence
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (ZEN-4532)

If you need anything redacted differently or want a narrower system boundary, let me know and we'll re-run the artifact pulls.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Trust Lead | Redwood Inference
